content:
marta: Proposal: add an opaque checkpoint token header so the edge can offer a best-effort resume for streaming requests without doing a full KV-cache sync. Edge returns `X-Edge-CP: <token>` during an active stream; client reconnects with that token to request a soft resume.

sam: Safety question: we must not replay streams that produced side-effects.

marta: Correct. Resume allowed only for idempotent/read-only endpoints (embeddings, read-only chat). For non-idempotent endpoints returns 409 or a read-only replay mode.

jade: Storage cost? holding many short-lived tokens could add memory pressure.

marta: Token stores minimal state: last-emitted-index, small KV-window pointer, model-compat hash, zone tag. Default TTL 90s-180s, tenant-configurable. Backed by sharded in-memory store with bounded LRU eviction.

nate: Add metrics and billing flags. Track resume attempts, successes, and reject reasons.

alicia: Suggested metrics: `edge_cp_created`, `edge_cp_resume_attempt`, `edge_cp_resumed`, `edge_cp_reject_reason` (expired, zone-mismatch, model-incompatible). Trace spans should link original request_id to cp token.

marta: Handshake sketch: initial
  -> POST /v1/chat/stream, X-Edge-CP: 0
  <- 200 OK (stream) with header X-Edge-CP: cp_abc123
retry:
  -> POST /v1/chat/stream, X-Edge-CP: cp_abc123
  <- 206 Partial Content (if resumed) or 409 Conflict + X-Edge-CP-Reason: zone-mismatch

sam: Region routing: for now tokens are zone-scoped; cross-zone resume requires replication and stronger consistency.

jade: Need admin revoke / bulk-expire APIs for compliance.

infra-bot: Perf note: 2m TTL increases ingress memory ~1-3% in simulations. Recommend tenant opt-in + global kill-switch.

alicia: Ops tasks: console toggle, dashboard cards, RBAC for revoke, docs with clear client contract (resume is best-effort; SDKs should fallback).

marta: Implementation TODOs: header spec + codes (206/409), compact token format (zone-tag + HMAC + small payload), sharded TTL store, admin revoke API, billing metering for resumes, SDK guidance. I'll open a short RFC PR and tag @sam @jade @nate for review.
